content: pg-boss v12.27.0 scheduling: schedule(name, cron, data, options) uses 5-field cron checked every 30s; 6-field format discouraged (parsed as exact-second, drifts); cronMonitorIntervalSeconds changes check frequency, cronWorkerIntervalSeconds changes run frequency; tz option defaults UTC; key option for multiple schedules per queue; schedule() updates existing schedule (idempotent). For a ~30-60s tick, minute-level cron (* * * * *) is the recommended pattern; sub-minute via 6-field + cronWorkerIntervalSeconds=30 but discouraged.
